test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The sound of thunder is heard much later than the flash of light is seen. What does this show?

options.text: The speed of sound is much less than the speed of light.
The speed of sound is thrice the speed of light.
The speed of sound is twice the speed of light.
The speed of sound is same as the speed of light.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The speed of sound is much less than the speed of light.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Sound **is a set of vibrations produced in the air column.
 
• As a result, the speed eventually drops.
 
• Since light waves are electromagnetic, they may flow through any material without the need for a medium, unlike sound, which NEEDS a material medium to do so.
